# Per-user limits + cost

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P3 · Act as the user](../README.md#phase-3--act-as-the-user) · **Lane:** Worker · **Label:** `feature:per-user-limits` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 5 (2S 3M)

Rate limits and cost tracking can be keyed by the verified user sub, alone or combined with agent, so one user cannot exhaust a shared budget. Analytics gain user columns and the dashboard shows usage and estimated cost per user.

## How we build it

- Config: policy.userLimits[] {match: {users[], groups[], agents[], domain}, rateLimit:"N/period", dailyCostUSD} plus policy.defaultUserLimit; carried on the policy wire; most specific match wins.
- Enforcement: Evaluator gains EvaluateFor(req Subject{sub, groups, agent}, domain, port, scheme); rate counter keys become user:<sub>|agent:<agent>|<domain>; denial reason user_rate_limited; counters are per worker (documented as approximate across a fleet).
- Cost: internal/cost estimate is accumulated per (sub, day) in the worker; on exceeding dailyCostUSD further requests to cost-tracked domains are denied with reason user_cost_limited; CP aggregates authoritative totals from ingested events and pushes over-budget subs in the policy wire as costBlockedUsers until UTC midnight.
- Analytics: ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN user_sub, user_email, agent (using the existing migration list); central ingest carries them; indexes on (user_sub, ts).
- Dashboard: /dashboard/api/users/usage?window=7d returns per-user requests, denies, cost_usd, top agents; Users view in index.html; Query Builder schema exposes the new columns.

## Done when

An operator can set a per-user rate limit and daily cost cap, a user exceeding either is denied with a distinct reason while others continue, and the dashboard shows per-user requests and cost.

### 1/5 · W-P3-PUL-01

**Add userLimits config and wire type**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Add UserLimit {Match{Users, Groups, Agents, Domain}, RateLimit, DailyCostUSD} and DefaultUserLimit to config.Policy with JSON tags so they ride GET /policy; validate rateLimit with the existing parser and require a positive cost. Update clone logic in config.go so hot reload copies the slices.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Invalid rateLimit strings fail validation with the entry index
- [ ] userLimits round-trips through GET /policy
- [ ] Configs without userLimits are unchanged on the wire

**Unblocks:** [`W-P3-PUL-03`](per-user-limits.md#35--w-p3-pul-03) Enforce per-user and per-agent rate limits in the evaluator; [`W-P3-PUL-04`](per-user-limits.md#45--w-p3-pul-04) Track and cap daily estimated cost per user

### 3/5 · W-P3-PUL-03

**Enforce per-user and per-agent rate limits in the evaluator**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add Evaluator.EvaluateFor(subject, domain, port, scheme) in internal/policy that runs existing allow/deny logic, then the most specific matching userLimit using checkRateLimit with key user:<sub>|agent:<agent>|<domain>. Add a counter eviction sweep so per-user keys do not grow without bound. Call it from the proxy where Evaluate is used today; deny with reason user_rate_limited and a 429.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] User A over limit is denied while user B on the same agent is allowed
- [ ] Group match applies when no user match exists; user match wins over group
- [ ] Counters for idle keys are evicted after their window

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PUL-01`](per-user-limits.md#15--w-p3-pul-01) Add userLimits config and wire type

### 4/5 · W-P3-PUL-04

**Track and cap daily estimated cost per user**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add a per-(sub, UTC day) accumulator in the worker fed by cost.Estimator results in recordAllowEvent, denying further cost-tracked requests with user_cost_limited once dailyCostUSD is exceeded. On the CP, aggregate cost_usd by user_sub per day from ingested events and publish costBlockedUsers on the policy wire, cleared at UTC midnight, so fleet-wide totals apply.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A single worker denies a user after the configured cost is exceeded
- [ ] Across two workers, CP-published costBlockedUsers stops the user on both
- [ ] The block clears after UTC midnight

**Depends on:** [`W-P3-PUL-01`](per-user-limits.md#15--w-p3-pul-01) Add userLimits config and wire type; [`W-P3-PUL-02`](per-user-limits.md#25--w-p3-pul-02) Add user_sub, user_email and agent columns to analytics
